fields.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Adoption
fields.subtitle: Turning AI assistance into measurable productivity gains

slides.action_title: AI-powered work is becoming the new productivity baseline.

fields.statement: Organizations that embed AI into daily work are creating a widening productivity advantage.

slides.action_title: Three barriers are slowing Copilot value across the business.

cards.title: Low Awareness
cards.body: Employees are unsure where Copilot delivers immediate value.

cards.title: Inconsistent Usage
cards.body: Adoption varies widely between teams and functions.

cards.title: Governance Concerns
cards.body: Data access and compliance questions delay rollout.

slides.action_title: A structured adoption program accelerates value while reducing risk.

claims: Copilot succeeds when usage is tied to business outcomes.
Governance and enablement must scale together.
fields.pivot_question: How can Contoso drive adoption quickly without increasing risk?
fields.verdict: A phased adoption model delivers measurable productivity gains and controlled governance.

slides.action_title: Productivity gains increase as adoption expands across priority teams.

fields.headline: Productivity improvement grows with adoption maturity
fields.required_data: Monthly adoption rate and estimated productivity improvement by business unit

slides.action_title: Four workstreams move users from awareness to daily usage.
Adoption reaches scale through four planned phases.
A phased rollout delivered measurable productivity improvements.

fields.challenge: Knowledge workers spent excessive time searching for information and creating content.
fields.approach: Introduced Copilot through targeted use cases, governance controls, and role-based training.
fields.outcome: Adoption expanded steadily across departments with strong user engagement.
fields.headline_result: Employees reported significant time savings on recurring tasks.

slides.action_title: Users quickly recognize value when Copilot supports daily workflows.

fields.quote: Copilot reduced the time needed to prepare reports and summarize information, allowing teams to focus on higher-value work.

slides.action_title: The next step is launching a focused adoption pilot.

steps: Confirm pilot scope and success measures
